summary: The Lightspeed intelligent assistant is an English chat interface in AAP that uses an LLM to answer questions; it needs AAP 2.6 on OpenShift and an LLM provider, sends no telemetry, and after upgrading to 2.6.1 uses TLS internally and is unavailable for about 60 seconds.
questions: What is the Ansible Lightspeed intelligent assistant?
Does the Lightspeed intelligent assistant collect telemetry?
Lightspeed assistant unavailable after upgrading to 2.6.1
